sloka: ते ऽर्दिता बाणवर्षेण भग्नगात्राः प्लवङ्गमाः।न शेकुरतिकायस्य प्रतिकर्तुं महारणे ।। ६.७१.४२ ।।
transliteration: te 'rditā bāṇavarṣeṇa bhagnagātrāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ।na śekuratikāyasya pratikartuṁ mahāraṇe ।। 6.71.42 ।।

translations.english: The monkeys were hard pressed by Atikaya's hail of arrows. Their limbs broke and were unable to resist.
